name: Salesforce
description: Connect your own Salesforce organization to manage CRM data from Imperal -- Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Cases, Tasks/Events, Campaigns, and any custom object via generic record tools. Run SOQL/SOSL queries and composite/batch requests, bulk-import or bulk-update via Bulk API 2.0, post to Chatter and attach files, read Reports & Dashboards, drive Approval Processes, send email, publish Platform Events, and audit your org (pipeline snapshot, stale opportunities, org health). Uses your own Salesforce Connected App (OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Flow) -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself. Note: this manages CRM data and declarative processes only; Metadata API deployments, Apex development (Tooling API), and real-time Streaming/Pub-Sub subscriptions are out of scope.

tools.name: connect_salesforce
tools.description: Connect a Salesforce organization by saving its Connected App credentials (Consumer Key/Secret + My Domain host) for the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Flow, after checking they actually work. You'll need a Connected App with Client Credentials Flow enabled and a 'Run As' integration user configured (Setup > App Manager > New Connected App).

client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: Consumer Secret of the Salesforce Connected App.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

my_domain.description: Your org's My Domain hostname, e.g. 'mycompany.my.salesforce.com' (Setup > My Domain). Do not include https://.
my_domain.title: My Domain

label.description: Optional friendly name for this organization connection.
label.title: Label

fields.description: Field API name -> value pairs to set on the new record.
fields.title: Fields

tools.name: run_soql

query.description: A SOQL query, e.g. "SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Industry = 'Technology'".
query.title: Query

include_deleted.title: Include Deleted

tools.name: continue_soql

connection_id.description: Connection id; omitted uses the only/default connection.

tools.name: run_sosl

connection_id.description: Connection id; omitted uses the only/default connection.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

search.title: Search

tools.name: run_composite
tools.description: Run up to 25 different sObject operations in ONE atomic-or-not HTTP request -- Salesforce's own native batching, not a wrapper. Each sub-request has a reference_id so later sub-requests in the same call can reference its result.

method.description: HTTP method for this sub-request: GET, POST, PATCH, or DELETE.
method.title: Method

url.description: Relative REST URL for this sub-request, e.g. '/services/data/v62.0/sobjects/Account'.
url.title: Url

reference_id.description: A label for this sub-request so later sub-requests can reference its result.
reference_id.title: Reference Id

connection_id.description: Connection id; omitted uses the only/default connection.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

requests.description: Up to 25 sub-requests to run as one atomic-or-not composite call.
requests.title: Requests

all_or_none.description: If true, all sub-requests roll back together if any one fails.
all_or_none.title: All Or None

tools.name: create_bulk_job
tools.description: Start a Bulk API 2.0 job for mass insert/update/upsert/delete/hardDelete/query/queryAll -- for volumes too large for single record calls or run_soql's 2000-row page (Bulk API 2.0 handles up to 150 million records per job). For insert/update/upsert/delete, pass csv_data (header row + data rows); for query/queryAll, pass a SOQL query instead.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omitted uses the only/default connection.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

object_type.description: sObject API name the job operates on, e.g. 'Lead'.
object_type.title: Object Type

operation.description: One of: insert, update, upsert, delete, hardDelete, query, queryAll.
operation.title: Operation

external_id_field.description: Required only for operation='upsert' -- the External ID field API name.
external_id_field.title: External Id Field

csv_data.description: CSV content (header row + data rows) for insert/update/upsert/delete jobs. Not used for query/queryAll (use 'query' instead).
csv_data.title: Csv Data

query.description: SOQL query text, required only for operation='query'/'queryAll'.
query.title: Query
